title: Rizq Foods: break-even and ratio questions
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: break-even and ratio questions with Rizq Foods accounts)
intro: Lesson 38. Use the data. Show your working.

blocks.h: A new product: the family meal box

questions.q: Calculate the break-even output per month.
Calculate the margin of safety at expected sales.
The price rises to £13. Calculate the new break-even output.
Calculate the gross profit margin for each year.
Calculate the net profit margin for each year.
Calculate the current ratio for each year.
Calculate the acid test ratio for each year.
In the portal box, analyse whether Rizq Foods' liquidity has improved. (6)
questions.a: Yes: the current ratio rose from 1.2 to 1.5 and the acid test from 0.72 to 1.0, so it can now pay its short-term debts without selling stock, making it less likely to run short of cash. But more cash tied up in current assets could be idle; inventory also rose. Level 3 (5-6): a balanced analysis with two developed chains of reasoning, both in context. Level 2 (3-4): developed reasoning, partly in context. Level 1 (1-2): points identified with little development.
